pairs.subject: quality-gates
pairs.evidence: lib/articles/checksStatic.ts:174 The `source-primary` (≥3) and `source-counter` (≥1) items count `primary`/`counter` booleans that the research agent writes itself into sources.json; ingestSources.ts:44-45 copies them through unverified, so the gated party supplies the very evidence the floor is judged on.

techniques.evidence: lib/articles/checksStatic.ts:174 The floor counts flags written by the gated agent (ingestSources.ts:44 `primary: o.primary === true`). Nothing upstream of the record checks whether a source is actually primary.
lib/articles/checksReport.ts:25 A dimension with no measured item is reported as not-measured and listed, never as pass: an announced, counted SKIP.
tests/golden-path/articles-checks.probe.spec.ts:60 Every static item is driven red with a seeded defect. A browser that cannot launch yields not-measured rather than pass (checksRendered.ts:81).
lib/articles/checks.ts:19 The label is honest: the check is advisory to the human gate and claims no blocking power. The blocking rung is said to be the registry gate.
lib/articles/checks.ts:21 Between-turn check, final check step, then the registry's blocking gate at landing: the same rules at rising cost, with the binding rung last.
lib/articles/checks.ts:3 The deterministic check is kept apart from the model critique. Only deterministic mechanical rules block, at the registry.
lib/articles/checks.ts:29 One THRESHOLDS table feeds both the enforcement and the prompt's description of it, so the writer is told exactly the bars it is measured against.
lib/articles/checks.ts:52 Bars are calibrated against the real population before use. The author is a machine, so a misfire costs one fix turn.
lib/articles/checks.ts:6 Rules no pattern can decide get no fake checker. Only count- and regex-decidable bars are mechanised.
lib/articles/checksRendered.ts:36 Type sizes and network use are read from the rendered page in a real browser, not by grepping the CSS source.
lib/articles/checkLoop.ts:107 The fix turn runs in a copied workspace and only post/ is ingested back (ingestPost), so the fixer cannot write the check code, sources.json or claims.json.

lib/articles/checkLoop.ts:23 The between-turn loop does not treat the critique item as its own question. With rendering off, the rendered items are not-measured rather than inherited from the static green (checksReport.ts:87).
lib/articles/checksStatic.ts:121 Each item carries measured value, bar and a remedy that can be carried out inside the post.
lib/articles/checksStatic.ts:154 A written house rule is mechanised as an item rather than left as prose.
lib/articles/critique.ts:227 Each disposition must name one reviewer/finding by identity, exactly once. One that names nothing is refused and reported.

lib/articles/critique.ts:378 Only presence of a reason is checked, but the writer chose the disposition and can produce a true reason cheaply, so this is the ordinary-rule cell, not the fabrication cell.
lib/articles/checkLoop.ts:60 The run advances with remaining failures written into per-pass records, which reach the human gate.
